text: A non-refundable cancellation fee of 6 months' rent is charged regardless of reason for termination.
Late payment interest accrues at 5% per day compounded daily until the balance is cleared.
The company may charge the customer's card stored on file for any amount it deems necessary at its sole discretion.
The membership fee may increase at any time at the company's discretion without prior notice to the customer.
Billing disputes must be raised within 7 days, after which all charges are deemed accepted by the customer.
A processing fee equal to 3% of the transaction total is applied to every refund requested by the customer.
All fees are itemised up front and the customer receives a full refund within 14 days of cancellation.
The security deposit is held separately and returned within 30 days less any itemised deductions.
Price changes require at least 30 days written notice and the customer may cancel before the increase takes effect.
No hidden or surprise fees may be charged; any ancillary cost is clearly stated in the initial agreement.
The agreement renews automatically for successive 5-year terms unless the customer cancels 180 days in advance by certified mail.
The company may terminate immediately at any time for any reason while the customer may only cancel after paying the full remaining term.
The subscription renews automatically every month and termination is only possible by registered post sent to the head office.
The contract renews automatically each year unless cancelled at least 60 days before the renewal date.
Non-renewal notice must be delivered in person during business hours; email notice is not accepted.
The agreement renews automatically and the renewal price may be up to 25% higher than the original term.
Either party may terminate the agreement with 30 days written notice and no penalty or exit fee.
The customer may cancel online at any time and is refunded pro-rata for unused services.
If the provider materially changes the terms, the customer may terminate without penalty within 30 days.
The customer is sent a reminder at least 30 days before any automatic renewal takes effect.
The customer agrees to indemnify and hold the company harmless from all claims including those caused by the company's own negligence.
The customer waives all liability claims and the company's total liability is capped at 1 dollar regardless of any harm caused.
The company is not liable for any injury to the member, even when caused by its own defective equipment.
The company's liability is limited to fees paid in the last 3 months and excludes all indirect and consequential damages.
Liability for damage caused by third parties acting on behalf of the company is excluded from this agreement.
The customer must notify the company of any potential claim within 14 days, after which the claim is treated as lapsed.
Each party is liable only for its own negligence and liability between the parties is apportioned fairly.
The provider indemnifies the customer against third-party claims arising from the provider's breach of this agreement.
Statutory consumer rights and remedies available to the customer are not excluded or limited by this agreement.
Fair wear and tear is excluded from coverage, and this limitation is clearly explained to the customer before signing.
The company may collect biometric and health data and sell it to third-party advertisers without the customer's consent.
The company disclaims all responsibility for any data breach and the customer waives all related claims.
The company may access, store and share the customer's private communications with marketing partners indefinitely.
The company may share customer data with affiliates for marketing purposes unless the customer opts out in writing.
Customer data may be retained indefinitely for business purposes and the privacy policy may change at any time without notice.
Customer data is processed in countries with weaker data-protection laws than the customer's own jurisdiction.
Personal data is encrypted, never sold, and deleted within 30 days of account closure.
The customer may access, correct, export and delete their personal data at any time.
Data is only collected for the purpose stated at sign-up and is not shared with third parties without consent.
A data-protection contact and a clear procedure for reporting a breach are published and accessible to customers.
All disputes must be resolved by binding arbitration in a foreign country and the customer waives all rights to a jury trial and class actions.
The customer must file any claim within 30 days of the dispute arising, after which the claim is barred forever.
The dispute forum and the arbitrators are chosen exclusively by the company and consumers cannot recover any legal costs.
Disputes are resolved by arbitration chosen and paid for by the company, with only limited rights of appeal.
All disputes are heard in the company's home state even when the customer lives and works elsewhere.
Claims must be filed individually and the customer waives participation in any class proceeding against the company.
The customer may bring claims in a court in their own jurisdiction and consumer rights are preserved in full.
Disputes are first addressed through good-faith negotiation between the parties before any formal proceedings.
Disputes are resolved by an independent consumer-arbitration body appointed by mutual agreement of the parties.
Each party bears its own legal costs unless a claim is found to be frivolous or brought in bad faith.
The product is provided with no warranty of any kind and the customer accepts it as-is with all faults.
Any warranty claim must be made within 7 days of purchase and requires the product in its original unopened packaging.
The warranty is void if the product is opened or used, and all repairs are available only at the customer's expense.
The warranty covers repair only and requires the customer to ship the product to the service centre at their own cost.
Warranty claims are reviewed within 60 days and replacement stock is provided only when available at the time.
The warranty lasts only 3 months and does not cover batteries or any component subject to normal use.
The product is covered by a 24-month limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.
The warranty covers the cost of replacement parts and repair labour for the entire warranty period.
If a warranted defect cannot be repaired, the consumer receives a replacement unit or a full refund.
Statutory consumer rights are in addition to, and not limited by, the terms of this warranty.
The company may change any term of this agreement at any time by updating a web page, and continued use constitutes acceptance.
All content, inventions and data created by the customer become the exclusive perpetual property of the company.
The company may modify this agreement at any time without notice and any change applies retroactively to past usage.
The company receives a worldwide licence to use customer content to improve its services and products.
Amendments to this agreement are binding once posted online and the customer is responsible for checking for updates.
The customer may assign their rights under this agreement only with written consent while the company may assign freely.
The customer retains ownership of all content they upload and may export or delete it at any time.
Any provision held invalid will be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable.
Either party may assign this agreement only with the other party's written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
The parties confirm they have had the opportunity to obtain independent legal advice before signing this agreement.
